device: Audiotec-Fischer Helix DSP Ultra S, output layer, 96 kHz
rig: ELECTRICAL loop, no microphone: Scarlett 2i2 out L -> Helix line in, Helix line out -> Scarlett in 1; out R -> in 2 direct as the timing reference, timing offset 0. Everything else in the channel off; no gain, level or routing changed within a set, so the ratio to the set's reference is the filter alone.
levels: REW electrical dB; only ratios within a set carry meaning
resampling: REW raw unsmoothed spectrum (linear bins), complex-averaged into each 1/96-octave cell with the measurement's own delay removed before averaging and restored after

files.what: phase control at 0 - the block's reference; both crossovers BYPASSED. subwoofer channel with the high-pass configured at 500 Hz and the low-pass at 5000 Hz throughout; only which of them is ENABLED changes between the three blocks
phase control at 90 deg, both crossovers bypassed
phase control at 180 deg, both crossovers bypassed
phase control at 270 deg, both crossovers bypassed
phase control at 0 - the block's reference; high-pass ACTIVE at 500 Hz, low-pass bypassed
phase control at 90 deg, high-pass active at 500 Hz
phase control at 180 deg, high-pass active at 500 Hz
phase control at 270 deg, high-pass active at 500 Hz
phase control at 0 - the block's reference; low-pass ACTIVE at 5000 Hz, high-pass bypassed
phase control at 90 deg, low-pass active at 5000 Hz
phase control at 180 deg, low-pass active at 5000 Hz
phase control at 270 deg, low-pass active at 5000 Hz
the same bypassed state captured 5.5 hours EARLIER the same day - a repeatability control, not a reference: do not divide the blocks above by it
caveats: Published to document what the bench's own drift is over a session, not to be used as a reference. Against phase-turns-bypassed-ph0 it differs by 0.013 dB rms, and by 0.081 deg rms once a 6.9 us time-base slip is removed.

note: The 0/90/180/270 phase series captured 2026-09-01, published 2026-09-03 after the third series showed the law only at the ends of the range. Kept one level above measurements/ because every .json inside it must be a Resonalyze IR file (tools/check.py).
